subtitle: The frame finishes. Safe casting still needs work.
caption: Unionclef portal work, not a release. Builder cleanup now stops its own waypoint walker while retaining an independent follow walk. Earlier interleaved course: portals completed 5/6 with cleanup off, 6/6 on, at 28–30 FPS. Four additional replays from one checkpoint completed 2/2 in each arm, but each arm had one lava death; automatic respawn and keep-inventory hid that in the old completion gate. The course now also requires zero deaths. Adjacent checks: navigation 18/18, cancellation 6/6, pursuit 3/3, mixed placement 3/3. Cast safety and the original full59 lava stall remain open. Continuing the diagnosis. HyperFrames CLI updated from 0.8.30 to 0.8.105; validation passed.
